Rationale: The Ground Truth models 'Courtroom' as an entity and 'Media_genre' as an entity connected via an 'Equivalent_topic' relationship. The Candidate instead treats 'courtroom' as a 'title' attribute of a 'Movie' entity and attempts to retrieve the 'genre' as an attribute of that same entity. This omits the relationship/entity structure (the JOIN) required to link the topic to the genre as specified in the Ground Truth.
